project_context: Megasoft Internal Operations Dashboard - Phase 1 Dark Mode Blueprint
theme_strategy: Data-Dense Technical Dashboard with Layered Elevation (E1 Archetype 4/1 Blend)

dark_mode_css_variables.instructions_to_main_agent: Inject these exact values into src/index.css inside the .dark selector. They maintain the brand's green primary and indigo accent while providing a deep, tinted-grey obsidian background suitable for data density.

badges_pills.green (success): replace 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' -> 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-500/20 dark:text-green-300 dark:border dark:border-green-500/30'
badges_pills.amber (warning): replace 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800' -> 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border dark:border-amber-500/30'
badges_pills.red (danger): replace 'bg-red-100 text-red-800' -> 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-500/20 dark:text-red-300 dark:border dark:border-red-500/30'
badges_pills.blue/indigo (info): replace 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800' -> 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 dark:bg-indigo-500/20 dark:text-indigo-300 dark:border dark:border-indigo-500/30'

toggle_button.placement: Sidebar footer, near the 'Cerrar Sesión' option.
toggle_button.design: Ghost button variant (Shadcn) with standard Lucide 'Sun' and 'Moon' icons.
toggle_button.interaction: Subtle scale and rotation. Example tailwind implementation on the icons: 'absolute h-5 w-5 rotate-90 scale-0 transition-transform duration-500 dark:rotate-0 dark:scale-100' for Moon, and 'h-5 w-5 rotate-0 scale-100 transition-transform duration-500 dark:-rotate-90 dark:scale-0' for Sun.

elevation_and_shadows.rule: Shadows do not work effectively in dark mode. Shift from shadow-based elevation to border and surface-lightness elevation.
elevation_and_shadows.implementation: For cards and dialogs currently using 'shadow-sm' or 'shadow-md', append 'dark:border dark:border-slate-800 dark:shadow-none'.

pdf_print_views.rule: PDFs must absolutely remain light. Do not invert colors on printable invoices/reports.
pdf_print_views.implementation: Do not apply 'dark:' utility classes to the inner content of PDF previews. Alternatively, enforce a specific '.light' wrapper around the PDF viewer component to override any parent dark class inherited from the system.

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AA required for dense data. Use tinted grays (slate/indigo tint) over pure blacks/grays.
accessibility.focus: Always explicit on forms: 'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-slate-950'.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup next-themes and ThemeProvider wrapping the layout.
2. Add the custom .dark block HSL values to src/index.css.
3. Implement the ThemeToggle button component at the Sidebar footer.
4. Audit Phase 1 target screens (Layout/Sidebar, Dashboard, Clients, Quotes, Projects). Add dark: variants next to the existing light classes using the mapping dictionary.
5. Leave PDF screens isolated from dark variables.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: DO NOT fall into 'AI Slop' aesthetics (generic pure black dark mode). Stick strictly to the tinted slate HSL values provided.
DO NOT use 'transition: all'. Explicitly transition colors and transforms.
DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or toasts in dark mode. Always use a solid background (e.g. dark:bg-slate-900) with a subtle border.
All interactive elements, buttons, and form inputs MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute formatted in kebab-case.
